derivation: Rules follow corporate-action semantics and filing language only. No threshold, window or tolerance was fitted on the 83 V4 diagnostic cases, the 74 adjusted-level cases or the 1.2.0 holds; those populations are regression/validation sets only.

secStages.APPROVED: board/stockholder approval, ratio set; no effectiveness wording; ranges are at most APPROVED
secStages.EFFECTIVE: effected / became effective / began trading on a split-adjusted basis; or charter amendment filed with a fixed ratio and a stated effective or market date (scheduled = true)
secStages.OBSERVED_IN_PRICE: assigned by the validation engine: the price or the provider factor shows the EFFECTIVE event on the stated session (window -2..+3 sessions; undated: unique day within 400 days before the filing)

CONFIRMED_SPLIT.when: SEC EFFECTIVE forward split (newPerOld > 1) observed in price or provider factor
CONFIRMED_SPLIT.outcome: NORMALIZE if the provider factor is missing, ACCEPT if the provider factor matches (1 % rounding)

CONFIRMED_REVERSE_SPLIT.when: SEC EFFECTIVE reverse split (newPerOld < 1) observed in price or provider factor

PROBABLE_CORPORATE_ACTION.when: price-only split signature or provider adjustedClose step, supported by an SEC approval/announcement whose fixed ratio explains the move or by an SEC share-count change consistent with the ratio

CONFLICTING_CORPORATE_ACTION.when: provider factor differs from the SEC ratio, an SEC EFFECTIVE ratio near the date does not explain the move, or SEC share counts contradict a price-only split signature

PRICE_DISCONTINUITY_NO_CA_EVIDENCE.when: only the canonical-total-return-1.2.0 price signature (frozen, unchanged) or the provider cross-check

UNKNOWN.when: SEC event outside the series, not visible in the price, undated and ambiguous, or undated without ticker in the filing

matchRule: a session matches an SEC ratio q when q explains the raw close-to-close move r better than no event: |ln r + ln q| < |ln r|. No further tolerance. Among matching sessions the best explained one is taken (ties: nearest to the stated session).
recordFields: sources[] (system, form, items, accession, filedDate | provider field)
identity (cik, basis: CIK_LINK / TICKER_IN_FILING / PRICE_CONCORDANT, cikStatus)
visibleAt (filing date of the EFFECTIVE document)
noSilentRepair: Only CONFIRMED_* may change a series, by inserting the SEC ratio as splitFactor on the observed session; split adjustment itself stays in return-series.js#splitFactors (ADR-002). Everything else holds from the event date; nothing is back-calculated from prices.
downwardEvents: Event semantics, not return semantics: SEC-confirmed forward splits are normalized like reverse splits; provider spikes that revert are invalidated bar-by-bar in both directions; listing gaps > 365 days end the listing (TERMINAL). Downward jumps without a corporate-action source (unit or currency changes, unconfirmed forward splits) get no new price rule; they are counted as unresolved discontinuities (no rule was derived from the known census).
pointInTime: Every stage carries its filing date; a view as of t uses only bars <= t and SEC stages filed <= t; a hold later resolved by a filing is reported with resumeFrom = first session after the filing.
